title: Reverse an Array
statement:
Given an array of **n** integers, print the elements in **reverse order**, space-separated on a single line.

Read from standard input and write to standard output. Do not add extra labels or debug text.
ioRules:
- The first line contains the integer **n** (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000).
- The second line contains **n** space-separated integers.
- Print the **n** integers in reverse order, separated by single spaces.
- Do not print trailing spaces or extra blank lines.

examples.explanation: A single element stays the same.
